text: もし　ぜんぶ　あつめたら　おしえてね！

structure.jp: もし　ぜんぶ　あつめたら

patterns.name: 〜たら
patterns.span: もし　ぜんぶ　あつめたら
patterns.explanation: たら on a verb means 'if' or 'when' that thing happens; もし at the front makes it clearly 'if'. もし　ぜんぶ　あつめたら = 'if you collect them all'.

patterns.name: 〜て (request)
patterns.explanation: A verb ending in て on its own is a friendly way to ask someone to do something. おしえて = 'tell me'.
